name: Adept Fuyu-Heavy
notes: Announced on January 24, 2024 as the model for Adept's enterprise product. The post includes text, chat and multimodal benchmark tables and a UI-understanding demo video.
summary: Adept multimodal model that scales up the Fuyu architecture for digital agents, aimed mainly at UI understanding; Adept reports MMMU, VQAv2, AI2D and ChartQA scores against Gemini models.
